== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The January and October slips differ in quotation marks. The remaster replaces the protected drain with a prohibition on It’s A Trap!, deploys the eligible Effect instead of taking it into hand, includes lore in the search and drops Alter immunity. A listed character winning a Cloud City battle still sends the Effect to the Used Pile.
